uncertainties.detail: 40943 inventoried functions remain semantically unresolved; analyzed status for small functions is limited to documented machine-level scope.
38574 static call sites have no resolved call-reference target.
Function inventory exhausts current Ghidra function entries, not all possible executable code. Missed/false boundaries, inline data and callback/exception continuations remain possible.
RPC names and use sites do not recover parameter/response grammars, permissions, registrations, versions, endpoints or complete effects. Dynamic RPC bindings remain unresolved.
Class metadata prefixes and selected projections are recovered; complete instance fields, register ABI, hidden outputs, variant arrays and lifetimes remain unresolved.
Five supplied DLLs have dependency/export metadata, but their implementations and dynamic ABI contracts are unresolved.
Selected signing/order/save/locking edges are verified; full state machines, policy, response parsing and error cleanup remain partial.
Stored forms do not establish inherited/effective properties, reassigned handlers, runtime focus, site configuration or accessibility parity.
Five verified finally-continuation repairs do not resolve all Delphi cleanup/control-flow ambiguities.
Input identity is hash pinned. Distribution authenticity and exact original Pascal/server source match are not independently established. No target execution occurred.
